查询指标，枚举选择

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO 流量转化率

description.en:
The metric to query. This is an enumeration.

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: The total traffic volume in page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: The total traffic volume in unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: The traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: The traffic per capita.

USER\_PV\_STAY: The average stay duration per user. This applies to content-based scenarios.

USER\_UV\_STAY: The average stay duration per visit. This applies to content-based scenarios.
The start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
The trace ID. This must be consistent with the data specifications.
